title: After the nightly restart the agent re-tests finished samples
area: Google ADK and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
scenario: ControlPilot's nightly CM-03 job resumes a persistent ADK session each night to test the next batch. After night two, reviewers see duplicate work items and the log shows the same changes tested again; no errors. On-call blames token-usage warnings and a GRC 429 retry.
task: Inspect the two-night incident bundle and the persisted session database
Prove why progress does not survive a new invocation
Fix progress tracking so a restarted process resumes correctly
Write root cause, scope choice and reviewer impact in ANSWER.md
acceptance: Two nights in separate processes test each change exactly once
One work item per exception; a third night tests nothing
Progress stored in a persisted state scope
Root cause and evidence in ANSWER.md match the injected fault

practices.label: Week 3 Tue - ADK sessions, state and state prefixes
